title: Counter-Strike: HyperSpirit vs Atreides (BO3) - CCT Europe Closed Qualifier: Series #4 Group B
description:
This market refers to the Counter-Strike match between HyperSpirit and Atreides in the CCT Europe Closed Qualifier: Series #4 Group B, initially scheduled for June 3 at 10:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to "HyperSpirit" if HyperSpirit win the match against Atreides.

This market will resolve to "Atreides" if Atreides win the match against HyperSpirit.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://hltv.org. However, if https://hltv.org has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

title: Will Valve add sticker trade-ups before November?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Valve adds sticker trade-ups to Counter-Strike 2 (CS2) by October 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

For the purposes of this market, "sticker trade-ups" is defined as an officially supported in-game mechanic that allows players to combine or exchange multiple stickers to receive a higher-tier sticker. The feature must be fully implemented and accessible to all players in the live game client.

If the feature is added as a limited-time, temporary, or beta mechanic that is reversed or removed within 48 hours of its introduction, this market will resolve to "No." This market will remain open for 48 hours after a qualifying feature is released.

For the purpose of this market, "Valve" refers to Valve Corporation, the developer and publisher of the Counter-Strike series.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from Valve; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

title: Will CS2 Add a Shootout OT by December 31?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Valve officially implements a shootout-based overtime format for Premier mode in Counter-Strike 2 on or before December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

A qualifying implementation is an official Valve update that adds, to Premier mode, a tie-breaking format in which a 15:15 tie is resolved through a series of 1v1 shootout arenas, as documented in Valve's official patch notes or update announcements. The implemented format must substantially match the concept of players facing off in 1v1 arenas with the match decided by winning a majority of those arenas. Minor differences in the exact number of arenas, the matchmaking of players within them, or the win threshold will not prevent a "Yes" resolution, provided a 1v1 shootout tie-breaker is officially added to Premier.

A proposal, teaser, survey, or statement of intent that is not accompanied by the format actually going live in Premier will not count. Unofficial modifications, third-party or tournament-specific rule sets, community server configurations, and datamined or unreleased changes that are not part of a published official update will not count.

The primary resolution source will be Valve's official Counter-Strike 2 patch notes and update announcements, however a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

title: Will ArrowCS eat a bug on stream by December 31?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if ArrowCS eats a bug during any livestreams between market creation and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

"Eating a bug" refers to ArrowCS placing any part of the body of an insect or other arthropod (such as a cricket, ant, beetle, or similar) into his mouth and closing his mouth during a live broadcast.

A qualifying bug may be alive, dead, cooked, raw, or otherwise prepared provided it is a recognizable part of the body of an insect or other arthropod.

The relevant part of the body of an insect or other arthropod must be a discrete item and retain its original physical form. Processed or insect-derived products, such as insect flour, protein bars, or snacks containing ground insects, will not count. 

ArrowCS must close his mouth with the relevant bug inside, defined as his two lips being completely shut. Merely holding, licking, or placing a bug in the mouth without closure will not count. If he later removes the bug from his mouth after a qualifying action, that will have no bearing on resolution of this market.

The full act as described above must be clearly broadcast on a livestream to qualify. Pre-recorded or edited footage that is not part of a live broadcast will not count.

The resolution source for this market will be qualifying livestream footage.

title: Will ropz Get Pulled Over Again in 2026?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Robin "ropz" Kool is pulled over by law enforcement between market creation and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

A qualifying stop occurs when law enforcement officers in any jurisdiction signal or direct a motor vehicle driven by ropz to stop, regardless of the reason for the stop and regardless of whether it results in a fine, a warning, or no penalty. 

Stops at fixed checkpoints or border crossings, stops of vehicles in which ropz is a passenger rather than the driver will not count toward a "Yes" resolution for this market.

A qualifying stop must be publicly confirmed to have occurred. Confirmation may come from a statement or footage published by ropz, from an official law enforcement statement, or from credible reporting. A statement by ropz will qualify only if it explicitly describes a stop that actually occurred; jokes, memes, or hypothetical references will not qualify.

If a qualifying stop occurs within the window, this market will resolve to "Yes" once it is publicly confirmed. A qualifying stop that is not publicly confirmed by January 14, 2027, 11:59 PM ET will not qualify, and if no qualifying stop has been confirmed by that time this market will resolve to "No".

The primary resolution source for this market will be public statements from ropz and/or local, state, or federal law enforcement; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

title: Will Valve add Cobblestone to the map pool by...?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Valve adds the map Cobblestone to the official map pool by the listed date at 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, the listed market will resolve to "No".

If Cobblestone is added to the Active Duty pool, it must remain there continuously for at least 48 hours for the relevant market to resolve to "Yes". Temporary additions (e.g., for testing) that are reversed within 48 hours will not count. If Cobblestone is added after the deadline, the relevant market will resolve to "No", even if the addition was announced earlier.

For the purpose of this market, "Valve" refers to Valve Corporation, the developer and publisher of the Counter-Strike series.

For the purpose of this market, the "official map pool" refers to the Active Duty map group in Counter-Strike 2 (CS2), which consists of the maps eligible for both competitive matchmaking and professional tournaments.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from Valve; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

title: Which teams will qualify to PGL Major Singapore 2026?
description:
The PGL Major Singapore 2026 is scheduled to take place from November 24 to December 13, 2026.

This market will resolve according to which teams qualify for the PGL Major Singapore 2026. If the listed team officially qualifies as one of the teams invited to the PGL Major Singapore 2026, the market will resolve to "Yes". Otherwise, it will resolve to "No".

Qualification to any stage of the Major (Stage 1, Stage 2, or Stage 3) will count. Invitations are expected to be issued based on the Valve Regional Standings (VRS); a team's projected or current VRS ranking alone will not count until the official invited team list is published. Ties in standings will be broken according to the official PGL / Valve rules.

If the PGL Major Singapore 2026 is canceled, postponed indefinitely, or if the official list of PGL Major Singapore 2026 participants is not published by January 12, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "No".

The primary resolution source will be official information from PGL (https://www.pglesports.com/cs2/pgl-major-singapore-2026/). However, a consensus of credible reporting (e.g., Liquipedia at https://liquipedia.net/counterstrike/PGL/2026/Singapore) may also be used.

The PGL Major Singapore 2026 is scheduled to take place from November 24 to December 13, 2026.

This market will resolve according to which teams qualify for the PGL Major Singapore 2026. If the listed team officially qualifies as one of the teams invited to the PGL Major Singapore 2026, the market will resolve to "Yes". Otherwise, it will resolve to "No".

Qualification to any stage of the Major (Stage 1, Stage 2, or Stage 3) will count. Invitations are expected to be issued based on the Valve Regional Standings (VRS); a team's projected or current VRS ranking alone will not count until the official invited team list is published. Ties in standings will be broken according to the official PGL / Valve rules.

If the PGL Major Singapore 2026 is canceled, postponed indefinitely, or if the official list of PGL Major Singapore 2026 participants is not published by January 12, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "No".

The primary resolution source will be official information from PGL (https://www.pglesports.com/cs2/pgl-major-singapore-2026/). However, a consensus of credible reporting (e.g., Liquipedia at https://liquipedia.net/counterstrike/PGL/2026/Singapore) may also be used.

title: Counter-Strike: Sissi State Punks vs Team LEISURE (BO3) - DACH CS Masters Regular Season
description:
This market refers to the Counter-Strike match between Sissi State Punks and Team LEISURE in the DACH CS Masters Regular Season, initially scheduled for October 5, 2026 at 12:00 PM ET.

This market will resolve to "Sissi State Punks" if Sissi State Punks win the match against Team LEISURE.

This market will resolve to "Team LEISURE" if Team LEISURE win the match against Sissi State Punks.

If the match is canceled (not played at all) or ends in a tie, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If the match is postponed, it must be rescheduled to a start time on or before October 19, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET (14 calendar days after the originally scheduled start of October 5, 2026 at 12:00 PM ET). If, by that deadline, the most recently announced rescheduled start time is on or before the deadline, this market resolves based on the result of the match as played. Otherwise, this market resolves 50-50, regardless of whether the match is subsequently played.

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://hltv.org. However, if https://hltv.org has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

title: Will Team Falcons win another Tier 1 event before the Singapore Major?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Team Falcons wins a Tier 1 Counter-Strike event between market creation and November 24, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, the day before the PGL Major Singapore 2026 is currently scheduled to begin. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

A Tier 1 event means a Counter-Strike tournament classified as S-Tier by the Liquipedia Counter-Strike wiki (https://liquipedia.net/counterstrike/S-Tier_Tournaments) at the time the tournament concludes. A later change to a tournament's Liquipedia tier classification will not affect this market. Events won before market creation, including the IEM Cologne Major 2026, do not count.

Winning means Team Falcons finishing in first place at the event. A change to the start date of the PGL Major Singapore 2026 will not change the deadline above.

If it cannot be determined whether Team Falcons won a qualifying event by December 8, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "No".

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the relevant tournament organizers and HLTV.org, with tier classification per Liquipedia; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

title: Counter-Strike: magic vs BIG (BO3) - Stake Ranked Episode 5 Playoffs
description:
This market refers to the Counter-Strike Upper bracket quarterfinal 2 match between magic and BIG in the Stake Ranked Episode 5 Playoffs, initially scheduled for October 27, 2026 at 7:00 AM ET.

This market will resolve to "magic" if magic win the match against BIG.

This market will resolve to "BIG" if BIG win the match against magic.

If the match is canceled (not played at all) or ends in a tie, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If the match is postponed, it must be rescheduled to a start time on or before November 10, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET (14 calendar days after the originally scheduled start of October 27, 2026 at 7:00 AM ET). If, by that deadline, the most recently announced rescheduled start time is on or before the deadline, this market resolves based on the result of the match as played. Otherwise, this market resolves 50-50, regardless of whether the match is subsequently played.

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://hltv.org. However, if https://hltv.org has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

This market refers to the Counter-Strike Round 1 match between FUT Esports and TYLOO in the PGL Masters Bucharest Group Stage, initially scheduled for October 24, 2026 at 3:00 AM ET.

This market will resolve to "FUT Esports" if FUT Esports wins 2 or more maps than TYLOO in this match.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "TYLOO". 

Maps won by forfeit, disqualification, walkover, or default are counted towards the handicap, provided that the match is completed.

If the match is canceled (not played at all for any reason) or ends in a tie, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If the match is postponed, it must be rescheduled to a start time on or before November 7, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET (14 calendar days after the originally scheduled start of October 24, 2026 at 3:00 AM ET). If, by that deadline, the most recently announced rescheduled start time is on or before the deadline, this market resolves based on the result of the match as played. Otherwise, this market resolves 50-50, regardless of whether the match is subsequently played.

The match is considered to have begun once live play begins in its first map or game. Warmup rounds and knife rounds do not count as the start of the match. A round forced live because a team did not ready up or resume play within the allotted time does not count as the start of the match if that team forfeits before the next round begins.

If the match begins and one team wins due to the opponent's match forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, the match will count as completed.

In that case, any remaining maps required to decide the match, including a map in progress or not yet started, will be counted as won by the winning team.

If the match ends due to the clinching map being forfeited this will count as a completed match.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://hltv.org. However, if https://hltv.org has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

title: Will insani leave MIBR before 2027?

This market will resolve to "Dark Moon" if Dark Moon wins 2 or more maps than Ducks in this match.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Ducks". 

Maps won by forfeit, disqualification, walkover, or default are counted towards the handicap, provided that the match is completed.

If the match is canceled (not played at all for any reason) or ends in a tie, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If the match is postponed, it must be rescheduled to a start time on or before November 3, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET (14 calendar days after the originally scheduled start of October 20, 2026 at 1:00 PM ET). If, by that deadline, the most recently announced rescheduled start time is on or before the deadline, this market resolves based on the result of the match as played. Otherwise, this market resolves 50-50, regardless of whether the match is subsequently played.

The match is considered to have begun once live play begins in its first map or game. Warmup rounds and knife rounds do not count as the start of the match. A round forced live because a team did not ready up or resume play within the allotted time does not count as the start of the match if that team forfeits before the next round begins.

If the match begins and one team wins due to the opponent's match forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, the match will count as completed.

In that case, any remaining maps required to decide the match, including a map in progress or not yet started, will be counted as won by the winning team.

If the match ends due to the clinching map being forfeited this will count as a completed match.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://hltv.org. However, if https://hltv.org has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

This market refers to the Counter-Strike Round 5 match between Joga de terno and Martians in the CCT South America Series 7 Group Stage, initially scheduled for October 21, 2026 at 12:00 PM ET.

This market will resolve to "Over" if Joga de terno and Martians play 3 or more maps in this series.

If fewer than 3 maps are played, this market will resolve to "Under".

Maps won by forfeit, disqualification, walkover, or default are counted towards the total, provided that the match is completed.

If the match is canceled (not played at all for any reason) or ends in a tie, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If the match is postponed, it must be rescheduled to a start time on or before November 4, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET (14 calendar days after the originally scheduled start of October 21, 2026 at 12:00 PM ET). If, by that deadline, the most recently announced rescheduled start time is on or before the deadline, this market resolves based on the result of the match as played. Otherwise, this market resolves 50-50, regardless of whether the match is subsequently played.

The match is considered to have begun once live play begins in its first map or game. Warmup rounds and knife rounds do not count as the start of the match. A round forced live because a team did not ready up or resume play within the allotted time does not count as the start of the match if that team forfeits before the next round begins.

If the match begins and one team wins due to the opponent's match forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, the match will count as completed.

In that case, any remaining maps required to decide the match, including a map in progress or not yet started, will be counted as won by the winning team.

If the match ends due to the clinching map being forfeited this will count as a completed match.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://hltv.org. However, if https://hltv.org has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.
